summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Register-modal country picker CORS fix, (2) new Deposit payment methods flow, (3) new Withdraw payment methods flow on Marbaji clone. All three review-request features PASS end-to-end via UI. No regressions observed.

issues: Country selector shows only the currency code 'BDT' as the primary label instead of country name + dial code (design nit; flag + dropdown work correctly and list 33+ countries)

test_1_register_country_picker.details: Register modal opens, currency selector defaults to BDT with Bangladesh flag, phone field defaults to +880 with BD flag. Opening dropdown lists 33 unique dial codes (multiple flags rendered). No CORS/console errors observed.

test_2_deposit_methods.details: After login as demo01/demo1234, Deposit modal renders 3 payment methods: রকেট (RO/Rocket), নগদ (NA/Nagad), বিকাশ (BK/bKash). Selecting বিকাশ reveals 2 channels (ইনস্ট্যান্ট +0%, বোনাস চ্যানেল +3%) and promotion dropdown lists 'কোনো বোনাস নয় x1', 'ওয়েলকাম +১০০৳ +100 x3', 'রিলোড +৫% +5% x5'. Entering amount 500 enables সাবমিট which advances to 'ডিপোজিট নিশ্চিত করুন' step showing BKA / বিকাশ / amount 500 / agent wallet 01700000011 / sender number + transaction ID inputs. Turnover x1 / ৳500 shown.

test_3_withdraw_methods.details: Avatar dropdown → উইথড্রয়াল opens withdraw modal showing balance ৳2,000, 3 methods (রকেট, নগদ, বিকাশ), auto-populated wallet '01700000001 (রেজিস্ট্রেশন নাম্বার)' in wallet selector with 'ওয়ালেট যোগ করুন' option, amount preset chips (1000/2000/5000/10000/15000/20000), turnover warning, and উইথড্র সাবমিট button. As instructed, did not submit.

critical_code_review_comments: Modal Escape-key close is not wired up (Escape key does not dismiss login/register/deposit/withdraw modals). Users can only close via the X icon; minor UX issue.

No data-testid attributes anywhere in the app; had to drive tests by Bengali visible text which is brittle. Recommend adding data-testid to Sign-up, Login submit, avatar dropdown, deposit/withdraw menu items, method tiles, channel tiles, promotion items, amount input, submit buttons.
In RegisterModal, the currency select shows only 'BDT' rather than country name — flag+code lookup works but consider showing 'Bangladesh (+880)' or 'BDT — Bangladesh' for clarity.
test_credentials: demo01 / demo1234 (client login, ৳2,000 seeded balance) — verified working
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded payment methods and demo01 user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features from iteration 9 review request PASS. Deposit modal has Auto ডিপোজিট tab (not tested). Withdraw submit not exercised because SMS/OTP provider not configured (per instruction). Escape key does not close modals — use the X (svg) button top-right of modal or click-outside. Avatar button is at approx x=1221 y<60 (immediately left of language flag). Deposit trigger button 'ডিপোজিট' in header top-right at y<80 opens the deposit modal directly. Menu items in avatar dropdown are BUTTON elements with Bengali labels including ডিপোজিট, উইথড্রয়াল, রেফার বোনাস, ট্রানজেকশন রেকর্ডস, পার্সোনাল ইনফো, পাসওয়ার্ড পরিবর্তন, লগআউট.
